name: 360Learning
summary: 360Learning is an LMS with a published Team plan at $8 per user a month for up to 100 users, billed monthly with no annual commitment, and quote-only Business and Enterprise plans. It enrolls learners automatically from filters, tracks completion on a dashboard and sends scheduled reports.

facts.text: The Team plan covers up to 100 users and is billed monthly, and the FAQ says it can be cancelled at any time.
The pricing FAQ says no minimum number of users is required and mentions a 30-day free trial.
Dynamic enrollment uses custom filters to keep assignments current as the workforce changes, and automatic re-enrollment recycles training for compliance.
Completion certificates include start and end dates, time spent, failed attempts and scores.
The product page states the platform is GDPR-compliant and lists single sign-on with Microsoft, Google and Okta.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Up to 100 users, billed monthly with no annual commitment. The pricing page shows a $ sign without naming the currency

contract.cancellation: The Team plan is billed monthly with no annual commitment and can be cancelled at any time.
